name: Mixedbread Search Subagent
description: Registers the Mixedbread Toast-1 model provider and a search_subagent tool that delegates local grep/ripgrep searches to a Toast-1 subagent.

baseUrl.description: Mixedbread API base URL. Defaults to https://api.mixedbread.com/v1.

apiKey.description: Mixedbread API key. Prefer the MIXEDBREAD_API_KEY env var or `openclaw models auth login` over storing the key here.

agentId.description: Agent id the search subagent runs as when that agent exists in agents.list. Defaults to "search"; falls back to the calling agent otherwise.

timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum seconds to wait for a search subagent run. Defaults to 180.
